review_scope: Area metadata, packet contract, client source, transparent banner artwork

graphical_client_acceptance.reason: The command environment had no existing graphical display. Isolated Xorg startup could not create Unix sockets; AF_UNIX failed with EPERM, and the approved escalation route was rejected by policy: sandbox_approval=false. A subsequent read-only inventory through the supported managed desktop CUA/Sky capability succeeded but showed no running windows and no registered Minecraft, Forge, Java game launcher, Prism or MultiMC application. No supported native Minecraft launch workflow was found. No terminal, file manager, browser session or alternate display was opened to bypass the restriction.
remaining: OpenGL alpha and Minecraft font rendering
Compatibility with the user's actual Naruto/modpack client

managed_desktop_inventory.result: Managed desktop responds; no running native windows or registered Minecraft game launcher. Browser inventory has no tabs; no browser was opened.
managed_desktop_inventory.action_taken: Read-only inventory only. Stopped without launching Minecraft or routing denied commands through UI.

reviewed_source.finding: Dedicated-server boundary has no client-side dependency.
Registers client events and display toggle. Received state is scheduled onto the Minecraft main thread and gated by current connection identity; disconnect clears the HUD.

Main-thread area state has disconnect/world clearing and heartbeat expiry. Each frame observes noncancelled Forge boss bars. Complete PNG UVs are placed below that stack while preserving bottom 74px and optional Field HUD bounds; artwork shrinks only to 260px, then falls back to compact text. Both hide only when no safe slot remains. Menus, debug overlay, spectators and dead players do not show the banner. Cached Shinobi Immersion presence reserves the top 32 GUI pixels for its compass and marker labels; this reserve combines with the boss stack by maximum and remains when that private compass option is disabled.
Server compares all four immutable display fields, updates after travel, and sends periodic refreshes.
Versioned server-to-client display packet bounds all string lengths, decodes UTF8 strictly, validates labels and rejects trailing data.
Pure GUI geometry for full artwork and compact text, bounded rectangle search, explicit no-space result, and per-frame boss-stack accounting.
Read-only optional public API adapter. It observes at most 32 rectangles for status, minimap, rail, armor, sidebar and contextual card. No private state access or third-party configuration mutation.

artwork.visual_inspection: Original pixel-art fox shinobi on a cream and gold scroll, gray plain forehead protector, red cords and kunai. Transparent exterior; blank center intended for dynamic game labels. No baked text or checkerboard.
artwork.generation: Generated by image_gen; saved unchanged. No raster editing or fake gameplay screenshot.

field_hud_source_review.api_shapes: PASS: 18 public constructors/fields/method signatures inspected after compiling all 82 examined source files; no Field HUD class initialization or game launch
compatibility_limits: No graphical coexistence was tested with this or an older Field HUD release.
Older or incompatible releases missing the observed public signatures disable only the optional Field HUD reservations. Boss-bar/hotbar spacing remains active.
Private transient arrival, target and durability card placements are not coordinated by this adapter.
When artwork cannot fit safely, compact text is used. When neither can fit, the display waits for space.

shinobi_immersion_source_review.observed_geometry: Top-centered strip y=3..16; markers and scaled distance labels extend through approximately y=32.
shinobi_immersion_source_review.integration: Cache Loader.isModLoaded("shinobiimmersion") and reserve the top 32 GUI pixels; combine by maximum with visible boss-bar space. No private configuration access or Immersion edits.
shinobi_immersion_source_review.limitation: The conservative reserve remains even when the private compass option is off. No graphical coexistence was tested.
